bosses.name_and_land: Forest Witch — Warden of Misty Forest Ruins

skills.name: Root Nail (C)
skills.warning_and_timing: 1 occupied/current tile; 1 beat
skills.effect: Low hit + Root for 1 short beat
skills.counterplay: Sidestep before first stamp

skills.name: Branch Lattice (C)
skills.warning_and_timing: 3-cell L; next beat another 1-cell branch
skills.counterplay: Follow red floor warnings, never guess direction

skills.name: Entangled Row (H)
skills.warning_and_timing: 3 contiguous cells in a row, 1.5 beats
skills.counterplay: Move to another row

skills.name: Moss Guard (utility)
skills.warning_and_timing: Self tile in muted ivory outline, no red
skills.effect: Gains barrier until root anchor destroyed
skills.counterplay: Focus one of clearly marked anchors

skills.name: Root Anchor (mechanic)
skills.warning_and_timing: Spawns 1–2 visible non-glowing root anchor markers on valid empty tiles
skills.effect: Next attacks extend toward those tiles
skills.counterplay: Break anchor via any block target; not hidden RNG

skills.name: Withered Crown (P2)
skills.warning_and_timing: Alternate 2-cell bars, second follows first after 1 beat
skills.counterplay: Exit first lane, do not run into next warning

skills.name: Forest's Last Knot (P3 finisher)
skills.warning_and_timing: 4-cell T area then one center repeat, sequential
skills.counterplay: Clear anchor first or move to shown safe tile

bosses.phase_rules: `>65%` teach anchors; `65–30%` 2 anchors + branch; `<30%` sequential T finisher every third cast. At phase transition boss spends one no-damage telegraph beat showing darkened roots. Builds that break anchors or exploit cooldowns feel good; a 1-cell starter Block must always be able to break one anchor.

bosses.name_and_land: Ogre King — Warden of Dark Dungeon

skills.name: Chain Snare (C)
skills.warning_and_timing: 1 tile, 1 beat
skills.effect: Slow/Root after visible chain squares land
skills.counterplay: Step out before hit

skills.name: Iron Cell (C)
skills.warning_and_timing: 2-cell line and one adjacent locked tile
skills.effect: Temporary unavailable cell for one beat
skills.counterplay: Choose parallel escape lane

skills.name: Hammer Column (H)
skills.warning_and_timing: 3–4 valid cells in a column, 1.7 beats
skills.effect: Heavy stamp and knock 1 legal square
skills.counterplay: Move sideways; no push into pit by default

skills.name: Rust Guard (utility)
skills.warning_and_timing: Self tile
skills.effect: Guard rises after he takes a hit
skills.counterplay: Shatter with second hit, poison bypass optional

skills.name: Broken Chain (C)
skills.warning_and_timing: 3-cell L on opponent side, strikes after 2 beats
skills.effect: Medium hit, marks location for echo
skills.counterplay: Remember shape and move in time

skills.name: Dungeon Collapse (P2)
skills.warning_and_timing: Clearly marked empty slab turns into pit after next beat
skills.effect: Board shrinks temporarily; NO instant pit under a player
skills.counterplay: Plan a new escape route; tile restores after 2 beats

skills.name: King's Sentence (P3)
skills.warning_and_timing: Two **separate** 2-cell bars in sequence
skills.effect: High damage if both hit; 1 beat between
skills.counterplay: Use the safe middle tile; guard last strike

bosses.phase_rules: `>70%` single chain + slam; `70–35%` temporary pit and recovery; `<35%` sentence combo. Always reserve two reachable non-pit tiles when building an obstacle pattern.

bosses.name_and_land: Frost Lord — Warden of Mist Tower

skills.name: Cold Stamp (C)
skills.warning_and_timing: 1 tile, 1 beat
skills.counterplay: Shift before landing

skills.name: Ice Fork (C)
skills.warning_and_timing: 3-cell L, 1.2 beats
skills.counterplay: Exit the L foot

skills.name: Glass Column (H)
skills.warning_and_timing: 3-cell vertical line, slow windup
skills.counterplay: Change columns early

skills.name: Shard Mirror (mechanic)
skills.warning_and_timing: Records last player-targeted Block shape, shows ghost preview then red tile warning
skills.effect: Repeats **valid** version on player tiles after 1 beat
skills.counterplay: Watch final mask, rotate your next action for safety

skills.name: Bell of Snow (C)
skills.warning_and_timing: Warn 3 distinct single cells sequentially
skills.effect: Small hits and stacked frost if stationary
skills.counterplay: Move after each stamp

skills.name: Frostbreak (P2)
skills.warning_and_timing: One tile frozen gray, cracks in 2 beats; if hit, applies Fragile
skills.effect: Temporary terrain hazard, no instant pit
skills.counterplay: Stay off cracked tile until resolved

skills.name: Last Winter (P3)
skills.warning_and_timing: First cross then a *different* 3-cell L, sequential; not whole board at once
skills.effect: Medium area hit on two beats
skills.counterplay: Escape to the shown safe edge; defense answers overlap

bosses.phase_rules: `>65%` Slow teach; `65–30%` recorded mirror; `<30%` rotating delayed patterns. Freeze should not disable both movement and cast simultaneously without counter.

bosses.name_and_land: Toad Matriarch — Warden of Poison Swamp

skills.name: Mud Swat (C)
skills.warning_and_timing: 2 adjacent cells, 1 beat
skills.counterplay: Avoid edge/pit adjacency

skills.name: Spore L (C)
skills.warning_and_timing: 3-cell L, 1.25 beats
skills.counterplay: Exit before stamp

skills.name: Sticky Cushion (utility)
skills.warning_and_timing: 1 visible dull olive hazard tile
skills.effect: Slows move/cast while occupied, expires 2 beats
skills.counterplay: Break/cancel hazard or route around

skills.name: Bog Choir (H)
skills.warning_and_timing: 3 separated single tiles; second beat expands each by one if valid
skills.counterplay: Move to area outside expansion; red previews expansion ahead of hit

skills.name: Toad Belly Guard (defense)
skills.warning_and_timing: Self tile outlined ivory (not enemy warning)
skills.counterplay: Multi-hit or shred then punish recovery

skills.name: Mycelial Wave (P2)
skills.warning_and_timing: 2-cell row repeats once on same locations
skills.counterplay: Don't return early

skills.name: Mother of Spores (P3)
skills.warning_and_timing: T-shape strike then one post-hit hazard tile
skills.counterplay: Dodge T and avoid lingering hazard; cleanse after

bosses.phase_rules: `>70%` single poison attacks; `70–35%` growth/repeats; `<35%` T finisher. Teach the exact growth mechanic using Sporecap enemies before boss.

bosses.name_and_land: Sand Sphinx — Warden of Buried Sands

skills.name: Sand Paw (C)
skills.warning_and_timing: Single tile, 1 beat
skills.counterplay: One-cell dodge

skills.name: Ancient Column (H)
skills.warning_and_timing: Up to 4 valid cells of a column, 1.6 beats
skills.counterplay: Exit column

skills.name: Sand Clock (C)
skills.warning_and_timing: 1 cell now + same tile after exactly 2 beats
skills.counterplay: Memorize the marker; don't return prematurely

skills.name: Buried Arch (mechanic)
skills.warning_and_timing: One empty slab gets a non-glowing sand mound, temporary impassable, 2 beats
skills.effect: Paths constrict; does not trap player alone
skills.counterplay: Choose route before column hit

skills.name: Shifting Sphinx (C)
skills.warning_and_timing: Two light-grey candidates displayed; only 1 turns red with 0.8s warning before hit
skills.effect: Single hit; fake markers are never red
skills.counterplay: React to final red warning

skills.name: Wings of Dust (P2)
skills.warning_and_timing: Alternating 2-cell bar, then rotated 2-cell bar
skills.counterplay: Move across first shape rather than chasing boss

skills.name: Last Riddle (P3)
skills.warning_and_timing: Sequence `1 cell -> 3-cell L -> 2×2`, each shown before resolution
skills.counterplay: Step through safe tile each beat, or guard last

bosses.phase_rules: `>65%` slow memory attacks; `65–30%` introduce grey candidate markers; `<30%` Last Riddle. Nothing ever inflicts damage from false hint alone.

bosses.name_and_land: Inferno Demon Lord — Warden of Hellfire Citadel

skills.name: Ember Press (C)
skills.warning_and_timing: One tile, 1 beat
skills.counterplay: One-cell dodge

skills.name: Furnace Line (C)
skills.warning_and_timing: 3-cell row, 1.1 beats
skills.counterplay: Exit row

skills.name: Cracked Cross (H)
skills.warning_and_timing: 5-cell cross where valid, 1.5 beats
skills.counterplay: Stand in a clearly safe diagonal cell

skills.name: Scorched Memory (mechanic)
skills.warning_and_timing: Re-warns one valid location hit previously, after 2 beats
skills.counterplay: Recall the last stamp, don't reoccupy

skills.name: Broken Hearth (P2)
skills.warning_and_timing: Mark one **empty** slab with orange fissure (not glow), then clear warning before it becomes a pit
skills.counterplay: Plan path, cannot directly open under occupied actor

skills.name: Ashen Guard (utility)
skills.warning_and_timing: Self tile
skills.counterplay: Multi-hit, pierce or focus after guard duration

skills.name: Citadel Verdict (P3)
skills.warning_and_timing: Alternating 3-cell line then 3-cell L after short pause
skills.counterplay: Exit first line to a tile not in upcoming L; block/cleanse next

bosses.phase_rules: `>65%` line attacks; `65–30%` delayed pits; `<30%` two-stage verdict. Enemy-tile warning red is still allowed, but no **red** lava/clothing/character VFX.

bosses.name_and_land: Storm Dragon — Warden of Sky Isles

skills.name: Talon Stamp (C)
skills.warning_and_timing: 2 adjacent cells, 1 beat
skills.counterplay: Step sideways

skills.name: Wind Fork (C)
skills.warning_and_timing: 3-cell L, 1.2 beats
skills.effect: Push one legal tile, no forced cliff fall
skills.counterplay: Dodge toward safe edge

skills.name: Cloud Step (mechanic)
skills.warning_and_timing: Boss shows destination square then moves after one beat
skills.counterplay: Target future square

skills.name: Bridge Fracture (H)
skills.warning_and_timing: Announce one empty bridge tile; pit appears after two beats
skills.counterplay: Cross before break or choose other bridge

skills.name: Storm Sequence (C)
skills.warning_and_timing: 3 one-tile stamps in traveling sequence, red warning per beat
skills.counterplay: Move perpendicular to advancing line

skills.name: Gale Ring (P2)
skills.warning_and_timing: 4-cell perimeter subset, not full-board
skills.effect: Moderate damage to designated ring tiles
skills.counterplay: Stand on interior gap or guard

skills.name: Skyfall Pattern (P3)
skills.warning_and_timing: 4-cell T then delayed 2-cell bar on different row
skills.counterplay: Hold safe exit; don't jump into cracked bridge

bosses.phase_rules: `>70%` teach gusts; `70–35%` one temporary broken bridge; `<35%` skyfall mix. If island grid is split into two sections, maintain at least one available traversable route or guaranteed in-place defensive answer.

bosses.name_and_land: Heart Keeper — Final Warden of the Lattice Heart

skills.name: First Square (C)
skills.warning_and_timing: 1 tile, 1 beat
skills.counterplay: Dodge/guard

skills.name: Memory L (C)
skills.warning_and_timing: Copies last player-targeted connected L or bar into a legal warned area
skills.effect: Medium hit, same cell count capped to 4
skills.counterplay: Read final floor mask, move to unmarked tile

skills.name: Quarter Turn (mechanic)
skills.warning_and_timing: Previews existing 3-cell L then visibly rotates 90°, final red mask has full warning
skills.counterplay: Act on **final** red, not preview

skills.name: Broken Unity (C)
skills.warning_and_timing: 2×2 target then square shard particles on each cell
skills.counterplay: Move outside square

skills.name: Twin Stamp (P2)
skills.warning_and_timing: 2 separate small patterns, one beat apart
skills.counterplay: Save mobility/guard for second

skills.name: Lattice Repair (utility)
skills.warning_and_timing: Restores one previously pit tile; self barrier for one beat
skills.effect: Shifts safe path and gains guard
skills.counterplay: Exploit newly safe floor, remove guard

skills.name: Form Dissolution (P3)
skills.warning_and_timing: 5-cell cross then 1-cell repeated center, each clearly warned
skills.effect: Large finale, always with safe path or shield answer
skills.counterplay: Use previous lessons: remember, move, block

bosses.phase_rules: `>70%` show simple primary shapes, `70–35%` shape rotation and twin stamps, `<35%` bigger form. On defeat the gold cube becomes steady and quiet rather than a violent non-square blast. Reward closes run.
